payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP array stores minimum problems to achieve i participants beyond k, using main round (c problems for n people) and additional round (d problems for 1 person).
payload.rationale: Solution iteratively fills a 1D dp array with recurrence min(dp[i-n]+c, dp[i-1]+d); this is a typical unbounded knapsack-style DP with one-dimensional state.
